title: Reference-corpus evaluation harness and drift detector for embeddings + rerank
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build a reproducible offline evaluation harness that uses a versioned reference corpus to measure embedding accuracy, reranker quality, and stability over time. Must support nightly batch runs, synthetic perturbations (typos, paraphrase, truncation), statistical significance tests, and automated drift alerts tied to thresholds. Outputs should feed dashboards and alerting rules so regressions on hosted and dedicated rerank endpoints are detected before customer impact.
acceptance_criteria: Daily job produces a reproducible evaluation report for configured model variants and dataset slices
Drift detector emits Prometheus metrics and PagerDuty alert when top-level metric delta exceeds configured thresholds
Evaluation artifacts (embeddings, labels, scores) are archived with version tags in BigQuery and object storage
Minimal end-to-end latency regression test for rerank endpoint integrated into canary pipeline
Runbook exists describing triage steps for a quality regression alert
design_decisions: Use a single canonical 'reference corpus' per domain instead of multiple small goldsets to simplify sampling and versioning
Evaluate with metrics: recall@k, MRR, MAP, hit-rate, cosine sim distribution delta, and a calibration KS test for score distributions
Statistical significance: bootstrap CI for recall/MRR and permutation test for mean score shifts
Store evaluation outputs in BigQuery (dataset: embedding_eval) and parquet snapshots in S3 for reproducibility
Drift detection based on moving-window baseline (30d) and alarm on >4 percentage points drop in recall@10 or >0.15 shift in mean cosine similarity
work_log: 2026-02-20: Ticket created by Aisha. Initial scope reviewed with PM/Research. Identified core deliverables and stakeholders.
2026-02-24: Architecture review with infra. Agreed on BigQuery for metrics, S3 for artifacts, and nightly Airflow DAG to run jobs. Action: Marco to prototype job skeleton.

2026-03-01: Prototype run completed for 3 domains (search, QA-retrieval, support-bot). Baseline metrics recorded. Found wide score dispersion for short queries — added synthetic truncation perturbation to test robustness.
2026-03-05: Data retention and privacy check with Security. Decided to anonymize query texts and retain only salted hash for example-level tracing. Documented on Confluence.

2026-03-08: Integration spike with rerank endpoint to measure wiring latency. Discovered backend batching increases 95th percentile by ~15ms for k=10. Follow-up: ENG-53890 to explore micro-batching knob.
2026-03-12: Implemented Prometheus exporter for eval metrics and created initial Grafana dashboard. Drafted PagerDuty playbook for regression alerts. Requesting review from SRE and PM.
notes: We intentionally avoid the term 'gold' to emphasize that this is a living reference corpus that will be versioned and curated by the data team.
Action item: Data team to produce domain stratification and label coverage matrix by 2026-03-18.

Follow-ups: add a lightweight online canary that runs 50 production-like queries against the rerank endpoint and compares ordering to offline baseline before any model rollout. This is scoped separately but will consume the eval artifacts.
